title: rhobound.gate/v1
description: gate.json, the machine record `rhobound gate PREDICTION.json --policy P [--readiness R] [--now T] --out DIR` writes beside verdict.txt and summary.md (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.1-6.6). PREDICTION.json is a report v2, or a refusal (refusal.v1), which rule 1 turns into inconclusive. Exit status: 0 pass, 1 block, 3 inconclusive, 2 when the tool cannot run. Each of the 13 rules is listed in order, evaluated or not.

advisory.description: always true in the first build (gate.enforce_not_earned)

preview.description: evaluated for a preview (an agent's declared inputs), never for CI

now.description: the time used for fit age: --now, or the clock read outside the pure function

load_scale.description: what_if only: the load point the verdict is of, a multiple of the fit's external rate (predict --fit F --load-scale S): the report's load.load_scale, or the load_scale number of a model.utilization_observed refusal at that load point

rule.description: the rule's token when it fired (fit_stale, unmeasured_delta, range_straddles, input_refused:<code>, ...), else its name

code.description: the finding code that triggered the rule, if any

variant.description: the rule's variant when the policy chose one: block_band_model on rule 10 under the policy's block_band model (the block test reads the model-only band; the value of a block is its low end, null when a corner saturates the entry and rules 8 and 8b decided)

policy.description: of the effective policy, after defaults

judge.description: a judge answer checked by judge-check, when one was supplied (ARCHITECTURE.md 7.2)

entries.description: under the policy's block_band model only: rule 10 at each entry, in the report's order, with both bands. pass when band_ms.hi <= threshold_ms, block when block_band_ms.lo > threshold_ms (inconclusive when it rests on lower-bound workers), inconclusive otherwise; an entry a corner saturates has no ranges. A range with an end JSON cannot hold (past float64) is absent and such a number null, as the rules' values

band_ms.description: the change widened by the model band, then by the biased constructs: the pass test

block_band_ms.description: the change widened by the model band alone: the block test
